description.line01: Software developer focused on backend development, with experience in C# and .NET, building REST APIs and applications with a focus on clean architecture and good coding practices.
description.line02: Experienced with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, relational databases, authentication, automated testing, SOLID principles, and dependency injection. I strive to build well-structured, testable, and maintainable solutions.

project1.title: Cash Flow API - Personal Expense Management
project1.descriptionComplete: A REST API for managing personal expenses, including expense registration, updates, deletion, and retrieval. The project demonstrates layered architecture, dependency injection, Entity Framework Core, PostgreSQL, business rule validation, authentication, automated testing, and centralized exception handling.

project2.title: Journey API - Trip Management
project2.descriptionComplete: A REST API for managing trips and their activities, with features for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting travel data. The project demonstrates layered architecture, dependency injection, Entity Framework Core, business rule validation, authentication, automated testing, and centralized exception handling.

project4.title: Factory Monitoring Dashboard
project4.descriptionComplete: A real-time industrial monitoring dashboard that simulates a shop floor environment, allowing users to monitor machines and production orders through an interactive interface.

project5.title: Personal Agenda
project5.descriptionComplete: A task management application for organizing daily activities, allowing users to create and manage tasks, view activities by week, and filter them by category and completion status.
